description:
Opened in triage (2026-10-11) for defk-pic, defk-siy, defk-n7k and defk-9za, which each need a relation between values that the range-fact machinery cannot express: it tracks constant bounds (lo/hi) and bounds relative to an array length (len_lo, len_lb and defk-upc's scaled facts), not relations between symbols. Missing facts: len(out) == n for out = alloc(e, n) with n = min(...) or div(...) (pic, n7k's out[r]); base + i < len(b) from i <= len(b) - base - 1, and a range start as a lower bound of the loop variable (siy); r * dim + j < len(m) for a runtime dim (n7k, a product, not a sum); i >= w and w >= 1 inside an if branch or after a raising guard (9za). Adding each as its own fact kind would multiply special cases in in_bounds?/3, add_facts/sub_facts, with_acc_facts and the report's 'nothing proves' text.

Deliverable: a design write-up (docs/research/relational-facts.md, and a draft ADR in docs/adr/ if it changes the compiler's fact model), not an implementation:
1. How facts are represented and used today (where they are created, merged at joins and loops, invalidated, carried into accumulators, reported).
2. A proposal for one representation that covers the four tickets, e.g. difference bounds x <= y + c between symbols (and lengths), with how comparisons in if/cond/guards and raising guards narrow them, how loops and joins merge them, and what stays out (products like r * dim + j: state whether and how n7k's index is covered, e.g. by a row-stride pattern, or leave it out).
3. Soundness argument (i64 overflow of the symbolic expressions, aliasing/rebinding, resume after yield), and the compile-time cost: measured on the test suite and examples, or estimated with a prototype.
4. Each of the repros in pic, siy (both loops), n7k and 9za walked through the proposal: which checks drop, which stay and why; and how the 'nothing proves ...' report text would name the missing fact.
5. An implementation plan split into tickets, with an order; note interactions with defk-fun (len_lb in reduce accumulators), defk-i5r and defk-5qk.

A throwaway prototype in a branch is allowed to measure cost or check feasibility; it is not merged. The maintainer decides on the design before pic/siy/n7k/9za are briefed.
title: Design: relational range facts for bounds proofs (len(out) == n, base + i < len(b), guard-narrowed facts)
